hypothesis: R32 factual 7-feature model is insufficient because it omits the informed-interaction intercept and uses an uncentered selected fifth physical effect; FIT-only corrected linear causal interactions and uncertainty can recover intervention-dependent action decisions without hindsight labels. Factual-only model result is not evidence of neural improvement.

task.source: R32 preexisting quartic action-conditioned law, no external/hidden source

methods.legacy: unchanged R32 seven-feature factual-only ridge, retrained on R33 FIT
methods.indicator: 9-feature ridge with informed intercept + quartic state interactions, raw factual probe delta; FIT only
methods.centered: same 9-feature ridge with baseline-subtracted selected factual fifth delta; baseline estimated only using factual non-informative fifth probes in R33 FIT; no analytic baseline constant or hidden q
methods.loss_label: P80 observed normalized actual selected return physical displacement decoded in FIT only
methods.uncertainty: FIT-only per-bucket squared residuals; never evaluator or heldout validation fitted
methods.variance_ablation: set fitted residual uncertainty to zero when scoring centered mean-only
methods.fifth_erasure: set exactly selected fifth effect tensor to all zeros before prediction; leave actual selected action and nuisance stream unchanged
methods.cold_restore: serialize float64 coefficients and FIT-only risk buckets, compare all choices

interpretation.positive: Handcrafted factual-only interactions and FIT-estimated centering or informative indicator can solve a heldout synthetic task. Not a neural causal representation, novel mechanism, open-world AGI, or scientific admission.
interpretation.null: Preserve failure; inspect FIT validation vs decision-risk calibration without tuning same score labels.
interpretation.limits: Same R32 quartic law with new return state ranges and q magnitudes; no independent mechanism holdout; no qualified neural/GRU/SSM convergence or capacity-matched FLOPs.
